text: {"final": {"steps": [{"id": "P1", "file": "inventory/stock.py", "change": "In reserve_stock, add validation of warehouse_id before any other logic: import is_valid_warehouse_id from core/ids.py and, at the top of the function (before SKU/qty validation or any ledger load), raise ValueError(f\"invalid warehouse id {warehouse_id!r}\") if not is_valid_warehouse_id(warehouse_id). This ensures the error is raised before the ledger is loaded/appended/saved, so nothing is recorded for rejected codes.
